name: obsidian-organize-marketplace
description: Personal-knowledge-management plugins for Obsidian vaults. Ships the obsidian-organize plugin with five skills: bootstrap (vault layout matching hermes-wiki-super's Clippings-processed / wiki / wiki-map), process_clippings (turn raw Clippings/ files into wiki/<topic>/ entries), research (gather source material), add_wiki (promote to topic note), remove_wiki (retire topic + archive). Additive over hermes-wiki-super's add-wiki / process-clippings.

plugins.name: obsidian-organize
plugins.description: Topic-organizer for Obsidian vaults. Five skills on the namespace:skill convention: obsidian-organize:bootstrap (vault layout), obsidian-organize:process_clippings (Clippings/ -> wiki/<topic>/), obsidian-organize:research (gather source material), obsidian-organize:add_wiki (promote to topic note), obsidian-organize:remove_wiki (retire topic + archive). Layout mirrors hermes-wiki-super.
